server.name: soar_flights
server.title: Rift Flight Booking MCP
server.description: Rift Flight Booking MCP lets AI agents compare live fares and book flights through Rift’s streamlined booking flow, with namespaced trip tools available on demand.

protocolMetadata.instructions: This is the public Rift Flight Booking MCP search tier. Use soar_search_flights for live airfare. Do not construct airport arrays. Rift resolves inputs such as New York to the correct city and airports. When the user selects a flight offer and asks to buy it, call soar_book_flight. It returns an OAuth challenge anonymously, then owns every required booking transition on the authenticated connection. Anonymous flight searches have a limit of five calls per minute and 30 per hour per source IP.

tool.name: soar_search_flights
tool.title: Search Bookable Flights and Airfare
tool.description: Use this when the user wants to find, compare, price, or shop live bookable flights. Origin and destination accept natural-language cities, metro areas, airport names, or IATA codes; Rift resolves city codes and bounded airport groups internally, so never construct airport arrays.

via.description: Require a connection through one of these airport IATAs.

sort.description: Primary sort before limit. Defaults to best (Rift app Best: price+duration+stops). Use price for explicit cheapest-first. For time-window requests ("around 7am", "must leave by 8") keep default sort=best or sort=price and use departure_after/before or arrival_after/before with time_mode—do not switch to sort=departure. Only use duration/departure/arrival when the user prioritizes that dimension over price without specifying a window.

cabin.description: Requested cabin class. Defaults to economy.

limit.description: Maximum compact offers to return after MCP filters/sort. Defaults to 15 after filters/sort; pass a higher limit (up to 250) or call again with a larger limit if the user needs more options. Filters run before this limit. preferred_time pin may add one extra row when the best in-window offer would otherwise be omitted.

stops.description: Exact stop count after search (0 = nonstop). Distinct from max_connections (provider upper bound).

origin.description: Origin city, metro area, airport name, or IATA code, e.g. New York, Bay Area, Heathrow, NYC, or SFO. Required unless slices is provided.

date.description: Slice departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

cabin.description: Optional cabin override for this slice.

origin.description: Origin city, metro, airport name, or IATA code. May be omitted after the first slice to continue from the prior destination.

destination.description: Destination city, metro, airport name, or IATA code.

departure_date.description: Alias for date; slice departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

slices.description: Multi-city slices when origin/destination/date are not enough.

airlines.description: Marketing airline IATA codes to keep, e.g. ["AA"]. Applied after search before limit.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code. Rift Flight Booking MCP prices flights in USD only; omit this field or pass USD.

max_price.description: Maximum total_amount in USD after search.

time_mode.description: How departure/arrival windows apply. prefer (default): soft time want but best-value ranking wins—"prefer morning", "around 7 if possible", "ideally 7am"; keep all offers, default sort=best, present recommended and when preferred_time_match is false also preferred_time_offer_id. strict: hard time requirement—"must leave at 7", "only morning", "cannot leave after 8"; drop out-of-window offers; recommended is best in-window.

passengers.description: Number of passengers when passenger details are not supplied.

destination.description: Destination city, metro area, airport name, or IATA code, e.g. Los Angeles, London, LAX, or LON. Required unless slices is provided.

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format for round trips.

arrival_after.description: Window start for first-slice arrival (local HH:MM). Pair with arrival_before. prefer (default): soft—cheaper out-of-window offers remain. strict: hard—offers arriving before this time are dropped.

passenger_ids.description: Saved Rift passenger IDs from the user account, such as self or managed traveler IDs.

arrival_before.description: Window end for first-slice arrival (local HH:MM). Pair with arrival_after. prefer (default): soft—cheaper out-of-window offers remain. strict: hard—offers arriving after this time are dropped.

avoid_airports.description: Drop offers that connect through any of these airport IATAs.

require_origin.description: After metro expansion, keep only offers whose first origin is one of these IATAs.

secondary_sort.description: Optional tiebreaker after primary sort. When sort=price, equal prices break by duration, stops, then departure (same as the web app) unless you set secondary_sort.

departure_after.description: Window start for first departure (local HH:MM). Pair with departure_before. Example ~7am: departure_after=06:00, departure_before=08:00. prefer (default): soft—cheaper out-of-window offers remain. strict: hard—offers before this time are dropped.

max_connections.description: Provider-side maximum connections (upper bound). For exact stop counts use stops/min_stops/max_stops.

departure_before.description: Window end for first departure (local HH:MM). Pair with departure_after. Example ~7am: departure_after=06:00, departure_before=08:00. prefer (default): soft—cheaper out-of-window offers remain. strict: hard—offers after this time are dropped.

min_checked_bags.description: Minimum included checked bags when bag data is present. Offers with missing/unknown bag data are kept (not treated as zero); use list_bag_options on a chosen offer_id to confirm purchasable bags.

age.description: Passenger age in years when born_on is unknown.

born_on.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

passengers_detail.description: Passenger types, birth dates, or ages for accurate fare search.

require_destination.description: After metro expansion, keep only offers whose first-slice destination is one of these IATAs.

include_fare_options.description: When true, include alternate fare tiers on each offer. Defaults to false so search stays small enough for agents; use soar_get_offer after selecting an offer_id for fare comparison.

mode.description: Current Rift account mode: test or prod.

sort.description: Primary sort mode used for the page.

error.description: Error message when the tool fails.

offers.description: Compact bookable flight offers after filters/sort/limit.

filters.description: Echo of applied MCP browse filters.

recommended.description: Cheapest matching pick plus optional preferred-time alternate.

result_count.description: Number of offers returned in this page.

tool.name: soar_book_flight
tool.title: Book a Flight
tool.description: Use this one tool after the user selects an offer and clearly asks to buy it. It handles Rift login, fare refresh, profile and saved-payment readiness, Sky/iMessage or SMS verification-code delivery (never email), x402 payment preparation, and final purchase. When more user input is required it returns action_required; follow that instruction and call this same tool again. Pending means Rift accepted the booking and owns completion while the airline confirmation code is still being obtained: poll soar_get_booking with pending_booking_ref and do not place another booking. Never present pending_booking_ref as the airline code. Tell the user the airline code arrives on Sky/iMessage or SMS, not their profile email.

id.description: Bag service ID from Rift bag options.

quantity.description: Number of bags for this service ID. Defaults to 1.

bags.description: Optional bag add-ons chosen from Rift bag options.

payment.description: Payment preference. x402 works only on standard Rift offers (off_0000B8*), not airline-direct off_soaragent_* offers. Rift uses the default saved card unless x402 is requested.

offer_id.description: Rift offer ID returned by soar_search_flights or split-ticket group ID.

seat_ids.description: Optional seat IDs chosen from Rift seat options.

resume_token.description: Opaque retry token returned by an earlier soar_book_flight response. Pass it back unchanged.

passenger_ids.description: Optional saved Rift passenger IDs, matching soar_search_flights. Omit to book for the account owner.

protect_booking.description: Whether the user explicitly opted into Rift booking protection.

x402_payment_id.description: Settled x402 payment ID returned by an earlier soar_book_flight response.

payment_method_id.description: Optional saved-card ID when the user explicitly chose a non-default card.

verification_code.description: Code Rift sent after an earlier soar_book_flight response requested verification.

accept_price_change.description: Set true only after the user accepts the exact customer charge returned by this tool; copy expected_charge_amount and expected_charge_currency from next_arguments. Acceptance never covers a higher charge.

expected_charge_amount.description: Exact customer charge returned in a price-change action. Copy it unchanged; never substitute the supplier offer total. If the same offer then costs at most 25% less in the same currency, Rift books at the lower charge; a higher charge, another currency or a larger drop returns a new price-change action.

split_ticket_offer_ids.description: Copy this list from a selected split-ticket search result. Omit for normal offers.

expected_charge_currency.description: Currency of the accepted customer charge, copied from the price-change action.

payment_authorization_id.description: Payment authorization ID returned by an earlier soar_book_flight response, if bank authentication was required.

mode.description: Current Rift account mode: test or prod.

error.description: Error message when the tool fails.

offer.description: Refreshed offer being booked when available.

action.description: Next action for the agent when status is action_required.

object.description: Response object type for the booking flow.

status.description: Booking flow status: action_required, pending, booked, failed, or cancelled. Pending means Rift accepted the booking while the airline confirmation code is still being obtained.

booking.description: Booking payload, including its internal pending reference while Rift obtains the airline confirmation code.

next_action.description: Read-only polling instruction for a pending booking. Do not submit a duplicate purchase.

resource_metadata.description: OAuth protected-resource metadata URL when sign-in is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rift Flight Booking MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rift Flight Booking MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rift.co/.

_published_faq.name: Is Rift Flight Booking MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Rift Flight Booking MCP scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Rift Flight Booking MCP's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Rift Flight Booking MCP scores 88/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rift Flight Booking MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Rift Flight Booking MCP in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
